name: auto_rest_after_end_then_start_again
description: ANH-181, the console left at rest after a finished programme. The shipped 30-min profile shortened to 1400 s runs to its own end; then nobody touches anything for 2830 s, twice the planned duration and far past the 1430 s (duration plus 30 s of grace) at which session_overrun used to latch over the machine at rest, take every acknowledgement back and refuse every start until the console was restarted. The rule must not fire: a START at 4230 s is accepted and a new session runs.
